findings.title: 3D spanning_flags uses 2D boundary indices
findings.evidence: At p=0.3116079 and 1000 same-stream trials, current slice counts versus correct opposite-plane counts were L8 33/327, L16 14/287, L24 9/288.
findings.impact: 3D width/p_c and C7 validation are invalid; keep 3D claim inconclusive.

findings.title: 3D runner silently changes configured sample sizes and tau storage
findings.evidence: Width samples are n_each//10; exponent slopes use min_n; main config tau_L=24 is absent from L={128,256,512}; nested sizes make ss[1:] empty.
findings.impact: Pilot/main 3D statistics are not reported at configured precision; tau is structurally empty.

findings.title: Nominal 3D result is a semantic pilot copy
findings.evidence: The two result JSON objects are equal after removing elapsed; main log starts L=128 and stops in L=256 width; no EXP-0013 result exists.
findings.impact: No completed 3D main measurement is present.

findings.title: EXP-0006 current runner cannot regenerate stored p50 and hardcodes C2 pass
findings.evidence: Literal denominator w1-p0 gives 0.79657/0.60913/0.47934 versus stored 0.49985/0.49859/0.59247 on selected cells; C2 subtracts a value from itself and sets pass=True; run_cell raises for non-bond_span while main iterates all configured systems.
findings.impact: Stored estimate requires provenance recovery; current named runner and control claim are not reliable.

findings.title: EXP-0007 silently drops nonconverged bootstrap draws
findings.evidence: Preregistered/report n_draws=500; stored accepted n_draws=495. FSS se_a=0.031707 versus tolerance 0.01.
findings.impact: Point estimate is compatible with 0.5 but not a precision validation at the stated tolerance.

findings.title: Q-M008 uses upper-prime normalization and broken BH/p-value formulas
findings.evidence: Code uses log(p[i+1]) while report says log(p[i]); 1-CDF yields exact zero; naive BH counterexample [0.009,0.008] differs from step-up.
findings.impact: Q-M008 persistence result is descriptive only until rerun with corrected method.

findings.title: Q-M008 1e10 segmented sieve drops first-segment primes
findings.evidence: Small one-segment test returns 157 primes instead of 168; first multiple starts at zero and marks p itself.
findings.impact: The planned 10^10 result would omit all primes in the first segment.

findings.title: Q-M007 40-cell p-values use wrong transform
findings.evidence: Code uses exponent 1/6 and 0.5*erfc; cell (1,1) stored p=2.05e-7 versus exact chi-square survival about 7.27e-184. Exact BH happens to retain 38/40.
findings.impact: Shape means may be descriptive, but stored p-values and fine-grained FDR interpretation are invalid.

findings.title: Optics bootstrap p-values are uncalibrated and epsilon-floored
findings.evidence: EXP-0002 has one exact machine-epsilon p; EXP-0003 has eight. A 2000-dataset null calibration of the same formula gives about 0.021 rejection at nominal 0.01.
findings.impact: Core C(M)/n-density CIs remain usable, but p-values/FDR are not calibrated evidence.

findings.title: Speckle controls are omitted, mislabeled, or disconnected
findings.evidence: Prereg freezes C1-C5/C7 but not C6/C8; code computes interior contrast rather than ensemble-vs-space; independent replication and FDR are not in decision; KS uses correlated pixels.
findings.impact: Core speckle result survives, but all-controls-pass language is overstated.

findings.title: freeze_config overwrites supposedly immutable preregistrations
findings.evidence: Two isolated calls to the same path changed the hash and replaced parameters {x:1} with {x:2}.
findings.impact: Preregistration-before-results cannot be enforced by the current helper.

findings.title: S9 reports contain monotonicity, fit-storage, and unit errors
findings.evidence: Q-S9-1 rate decreases from 0.0617 at complexity .05 to .0567 at .10; JSON stores assumed rather than fitted parameters; .483 is used as an absolute increment but reported as relative percent; cited q_s9_1_complexity.py is absent.
findings.impact: S9 remains invalid, with additional report-level contradictions.

findings.title: Application descriptors/evidence labels and depiction API are wrong
findings.evidence: Ethanol formal_charge field is 0.3966637 while RDKit formal charge is 0; valid dissimilar reaction inputs become E3 POTENTIAL_INTERACTION; get_2d_structure raises Boost.Python.ArgumentError; one test assertion ends in `or True`.
findings.impact: Application outputs are not reliable scientific measurements even though the main pytest suite passes.

findings.title: result_hash is not a consistent artifact-byte integrity check
findings.evidence: Recorded hashes match neither exact result-file bytes nor canonical hashes of the loaded config result objects for EXP-0002/0003.
findings.impact: Metadata cannot independently prove which result object was hashed.

findings.title: EXP-0015 is a colliding phantom investigation
findings.evidence: Both water-response projects claim EXP-0015; the acoustics directory lacks the advertised CODE/RESULTS/CONFIG/REPLICATION artifacts, the fluid directory has only README/QUESTION, and the root registry has no EXP-0015 entry.
findings.impact: Automated retrieval cannot identify a real EXP-0015 implementation or result.

findings.title: EXP-0003 sub-agent artifact hash manifest is malformed JSON
findings.evidence: The file ends with the literal characters backslash-n after the closing brace; json.loads reports Extra data at line 195.
findings.impact: The audit artifact-integrity manifest cannot be machine-validated as written.

findings.title: Passing pytest mutates the persistent SQLite database
findings.evidence: A clean python -m pytest run changed the database hash from e7dfc79cdb696b39ae3578e4427b0a026b107655a1a359c5562edc2d46b087b9 to 1d925f3b0b2b19ce42a10e92b9ca02e22e1a9250df40eb34475bd6713a4b2cf1; all table counts were zero. The baseline copy was restored.
findings.impact: A green test run is not read-only and can invalidate artifact hashes or contaminate persistent state.

findings.title: Historical EXP-0003 complex field has a factor-of-two power normalization defect
findings.evidence: The independent calibration measures legacy nested power at about 0.5004 of target.
findings.impact: Absolute field-power claims are invalid; density ratios are unchanged because global amplitude cancels.

findings.title: EXP-0009 C7 uses identical frozen streams
findings.evidence: C7 uses the same G_LAB labels/seeds and first 40 realizations; Mmax/chi are bit-identical.
findings.impact: It validates the union-find implementation, not independent sampling or a fresh exponent replication.

findings.title: EXP-0008 first prime-gap bin is mathematically impossible
findings.evidence: For the stated odd-prime blocks delta >= 2/log(10^8)=0.10857362047581294, above the first edge 0.10536051565782628; all four first-bin counts are zero while Exp(1) assigns roughly 10 percent.
findings.impact: The empty-bin anomaly is structural and cannot support a novel prime-gap process or the Q-M007 38/40 interpretation.

findings.title: EXP-0009 R3 is algebraically coupled to the D_f mass data
findings.evidence: P_inf is M_max/L^2 from the same mass arrays used for D_f; beta/nu is the negative slope of that P_inf sequence, so R3 residual ~0.000757 is an algebraic identity check.
findings.impact: R3 must be labelled internal consistency, not independent physical scaling evidence.

findings.title: EXP-0010 uses a pooled D_f gate instead of the preregistered per-size non-power-of-two gate
findings.evidence: The runner computes one pooled D_f slope, stores only C1, and leaves the 1/nu branch as a no-op; the preregistration requires per-size D_f checks and C7.
findings.impact: EXP-0010 cannot close the historical lattice-artifact claim under its own protocol.

findings.title: Q-M007 audit writer is hardcoded and contradicts the later report
findings.evidence: The writer has no JSON-loading dependency, emits a literal H1_SUPPORTED verdict, and says no 40-cell BH was applied while the later report says 38/40 survived.
findings.impact: Q-M007 verification language is not self-authenticating; retain only descriptive raw-bin observations.

findings.title: Q-P007 has colliding writers, hardcoded phase-1 p_c inputs, and a no-op 1/nu branch
findings.evidence: Two writers target the same result path; one requests nonexistent engine keys; phase-2 p_c values/sigmas are literals and the 1/nu loop is empty.
findings.impact: The refined-p_c closure cannot be regenerated from one canonical pipeline.

findings.title: Registry, Git chronology, and central data stores are not authoritative
findings.evidence: All 21 SQLite tables and the advertised central stores are empty; the enclosing Git repository has zero commits and project files are untracked; registry/status records disagree.
findings.impact: Completion, identity, and chronology claims cannot be inferred from status text alone.
